description: Momentum-based trading with RSI, EMA and Volume indicators

rsi_threshold.name: RSI Threshold
rsi_threshold.description: Threshold for RSI-based signals. Lower values = more buy signals (oversold). Higher values = more sell signals (overbought).
rsi_threshold.impact: Primary signal filter. Affects trade frequency and quality.

momentum_threshold.name: Momentum Threshold
momentum_threshold.description: Minimum momentum required for signals. Lower = more sensitive to price changes.
momentum_threshold.impact: Filters weak signals. Reduces noise but may miss opportunities.

stop_loss.name: Stop Loss
stop_loss.description: Maximum loss before position is closed automatically.
stop_loss.impact: Risk management. Limits downside on losing trades.

take_profit.name: Take Profit
take_profit.description: Target profit before position is closed automatically.
take_profit.impact: Profit targeting. Locks in gains before reversals.

max_position_size.name: Max Position Size
max_position_size.description: Maximum fraction of capital allocated per trade.
max_position_size.impact: Capital allocation. Diversification and risk management.

ema_fast.name: EMA Fast Period
ema_fast.description: Short-term EMA period for trend detection.
ema_fast.impact: Trend sensitivity. Lower = more reactive to price changes.

ema_slow.name: EMA Slow Period
ema_slow.description: Long-term EMA period for trend detection.
ema_slow.impact: Trend sensitivity. Higher = smoother, less noise.
